_meta.source: Wilson et al. (2016) OPP-115 — adapted for PrivacyLens

categories.label: First-Party Collection & Use
categories.description: What data the company itself collects and how it uses it

categories.label: Third-Party Sharing & Collection
categories.description: Whether and how data is shared with or collected by third parties

categories.label: User Choice & Control
categories.description: Options the user has to opt-in, opt-out, or limit data use

categories.label: User Access, Edit & Deletion
categories.description: Rights to access, correct, or delete personal data

categories.label: Data Retention
categories.description: How long data is kept and criteria for deletion

categories.label: Data Security
categories.description: Technical and organisational measures to protect data

categories.label: Policy Change
categories.description: How and when users are notified of policy updates

categories.label: Do Not Track
categories.description: Whether the company honours browser Do Not Track signals

categories.label: International & Specific Audiences
categories.description: Age restrictions, children's data, international data transfers

categories.label: Financial Data
categories.description: Collection and handling of payment or financial information

categories.label: Location Data
categories.description: Collection and use of geographic or GPS location information

categories.label: Contact Information
categories.description: Collection of email, phone, address, and similar identifiers
